description:
Discover Convenient Living in East Austin

Welcome home to The Patten East Apartments, your new haven of spacious living and relaxation. Whether you're searching for a 1- or 2-bedroom apartment home, we have the perfect floor plan to suit your lifestyle. Our premier location off East Riverside is just South of Downtown Austin and nestled in the growing neighborhood of East Riverside-Oltorf, and the vibrant lifestyle of South Congress is just a couple of minutes away. The Patten East's excellent location, mere minutes from downtown Austin, places you near several area schools and employers such as The University of Texas Austin, St. Edward's University, Austin-Bergstrom International Airport, Tesla, Oracle, and Deloitte. With the Patten East's close proximity to I-35 and Highway 71, you're just minutes from all East Austin has to offer, from trending restaurants to popular hiking and bike trails, and so much more!
